notes: Trimming detail length after earlier submission issues; same 3 reports as planned, worded more concisely to stay within limits.

requests.title: Top merchants: year-over-year holiday-quarter growth
requests.question: For the biggest merchants, is Oct-Dec revenue really growing year over year, or is the recent growth just holiday seasonality?
requests.details: Tables orders, tenants, exchange_rates. Window A is placed_at Oct 1 to Dec 31 2025. Window B is placed_at Oct 1 to Dec 31 2024. Exclude cancelled orders. Convert to EUR using daily exchange_rates matched to placed_at date. growth pct equals A minus B divided by B, blank if B is zero. Order by window A revenue descending, tie-break tenant_id. Cap 50 rows.
builds_on: Merchant size and recent growth trend

requests.title: Merchant risk signals: refunds, cancellations, unpaid invoices, shopper drop-off
requests.question: Which merchants show warning signs right now: rising refunds or cancellations, unpaid invoices, or falling shopper activity?
requests.details: Tables payment_refunds joined to payments for refund rate, equal to refund EUR divided by captured payment EUR per period. Orders for cancellation rate, equal to cancelled orders divided by all orders placed per period. Invoices for overdue amount, equal to amount_due in EUR where status is past_due, or status is open with due date already passed as of 2026-01-05. Web_sessions for session counts per period. Convert money via exchange_rates. Periods: last 90 days is Oct 3 to Dec 31 2025; prior 90 days is Jul 5 to Oct 2 2025. Order by overdue invoice amount EUR descending, tie-break refund rate last 90 days descending, then tenant_id. Cap 50 rows.
builds_on: Merchant size and recent growth trend

requests.title: Merchant customer base health: repeat purchase rate
requests.question: For each merchant, how much of their customer base is repeat buyers versus one-and-done, over the last 12 months?
columns: distinct customers with at least one order in last 12 months
repeat customers with at least two orders in last 12 months
average orders per customer last 12 months
requests.details: Table orders: count distinct user_id per tenant with order counts over placed_at Jan 1 to Dec 31 2025, excluding cancelled orders. Join tenants for name and industry. repeat purchase rate pct equals repeat customers divided by distinct customers. average orders per customer equals total orders divided by distinct customers. Order by distinct customers descending, tie-break repeat purchase rate descending, then tenant_id. Cap 50 rows.
